title: Planting Cowpea protocol
author: Stephanie Cullum

steps_raw.instruction: Collect 48 plastic 4 gallon plant pots for cowpea planting
The soil mixture is one part LC1 soil (Sun Gro Horticulture Professional growing mix SS#1-F1P RSI) and one part calcined clay (Turface Athletics MVP 32217).
To make all the soil mixture, make it in smaller portions to allow easier mixing e.g. 10 scoops (each 2 quarts) of alternating clay and soil to a large pot.
Mix up the dry mixture with a shovel or hands untill even distribution
Add 2 litre of water to the soil and again mix so that all soil has equal moisture

steps_raw.title: Fill all the pots with the mixture leaving 3cm of space from the lid of the pot.
steps_raw.instruction: Pat down the soil gentle to give it some firmness (but still allowing movement for seeding)
Each of the 12 cow pea accessions have 4 plant pots with each plant pot containing 2 seeds meaning that each accession has 8 seeds planted.
The seed placement within the pot should be that the 2 seeds are planted 7 cm apart but should be placed near the centre of the plant pot.

To plant the seeds, create a hole in the soil that is 2cm deep by using your fingertip. Place the seed within the created hole and then cover the seed with soil. Repeat with seeds while labelling each pot with the accession number
Thoughly water each pot once the seeds are planted
Check on the gorwing plants once a day. If the soil becomes dry then rewater all the pots
